molecular_glues.abstract: Mathematics > Rings and Algebras arXiv:2610.27300 (math) [Submitted on 19 Oct 2026] Title: The algebraic and geometric classification of post-$3$-Lie algebras Authors: Hani Abdelwahab , Kobiljon Abdurasulov , Ivan Kaygorodov View a PDF of the paper titled The algebraic and geometric classification of post-$3$-Lie algebras, by Hani Abdelwahab and 1 other authors View PDF HTML (experimental) Abstract: A post-$3$-Lie algebra is a $3$-Lie algebra with an additional ternary multiplication, skew-symmetric in the first two arguments, related to the bracket by four compatibility identities. We give the algebraic and geometric classification of complex $2$- and $3$-dimensional post-$3$-Lie algebras and of complex $4$-dimensional nilpotent post-$3$-Lie algebras. The variety of $2$-dimensional algebras is irreducible of dimension $4$; the variety of $3$-dimensional algebras has dimension $12$ and $12$ irreducible components, and exactly one rigid algebra; the variety of $4$-dimensional nilpotent algebras has dimension $14$, two irreducible components and no rigid algebras. Abstract The minimal number of inputs in the local function of a non-trivial cellular automaton is two. Such a function can be viewed as as a kind of binary operation. If this operation is associative, it forms, together with the set of states, a semigroup. There are 18 semigroups of order 3 up to equivalence, and they define 18 cellular automata rules with three states. We investigate these rules with respect to solvability and show that all of them are solvable, meaning that the state of a given cell after n iterations can be expressed by an explicit formula. We derive the relevant formulae for all 18 rules using some additional properties possessed by particular semigroups of order 3, such as commutativity and idempotence.
